missing_claims.claim: TruePrime requires a synthetic amplification oligo with a published fixed sequence
missing_claims.evidence: Picher Fig. 9 and Whole genome amplification Methods describe TthPrimPol de novo primers; random hexamers are a comparator. The Fig. 3a GTCC/T assay template and Dean 2001 random primers are not TruePrime WGA reagents.

missing_claims.claim: The downstream NEBNext adapter and index bases for Picher purified-DNA sequencing are known
missing_claims.evidence: Picher Sequencing Methods gives only “NebNext (NEB)”, with no kit generation, index member or adapter sequence; GATC-specific selection is unidentified.

conclusion: Two independent readers checked the original Picher methods, supplements, vendor/predecessor sources and SRA SRP085855 metadata. The original purified-DNA and single-cell branches remain distinct; later V2 lysis and predecessor random primers are not assigned to the study. ENA confirms TruePrime WGA runs but supplies no library-construction protocol. Exact downstream NEBNext kit and adapter identity remain unresolved, so no absence is accepted.
